recommendation: Keep this no-change audit for FHIR-40308. Handle the broader question of whether these local code systems should remain complete, become fragments, or move to HTA/ISBT canonical terminology through the later dedicated issues, especially FHIR-49979/FHIR-53477/FHIR-55000, when that broader scope is ready to apply.
issue_request: FHIR-40308 was an Applied/Persuasive OO technical correction for R6 reporting that ValueSet/biologicallyderived-product-property-type-codes could not be expanded because the publication tooling could not support CodeSystem http://hl7.org/fhir/biologicallyderived-product-property-type-codes.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-40308. The preceding FHIR-38365 link fix was applied in commit 5ead0fbf61. The expansion failure appears to have been resolved later by commit 1d62083442 for FHIR-49688, which changed source/biologicallyderivedproduct/codesystem-biologicallyderived-product-property-type-codes.xml from content=example back to content=complete because BDP code systems were not expanding when marked as example.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source has the property-type CodeSystem marked complete while the ValueSet composes from that local system and BiologicallyDerivedProduct.property.type keeps the example binding. Later related issues FHIR-49979, FHIR-53477, FHIR-55000, and FHIR-55252 discuss replacing or moving the local ISBT-related code systems, but they are Resolved - change required or Triaged rather than Applied/Published in this default run scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source no longer has the example content setting that caused the expansion failure, and the rendered CI build page no longer contains the reported expansion error text and includes the expected four codes.
